doc.title: John Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 18, 2023 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Thanks, the Hamilton piano and goodbye
summary: Rowe thanks him, they joke about the Hamilton piano, and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: And congratulations on your career. And I appreciate the fantastic job you did at our Fallcoming event.
And I wish you continued success, John.

Well we were on a gig the other night at a school, a high school. And when Isaiah came in I said, “You remember that piano at Hamilton?” And he said, “Yeah.” I said, “This isn’t that.” So I’ll leave you with that.
I was sitting right in the front row with the top up. Wow man. That thing was powerful and he’s a powerful player.
He sure is. He loved that piano. He was still talking about it.
All right. Well thanks for your time today and keep at it.
You got it my friend. Thanks Monk, appreciate it.
